items.title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
items.summary: Between October 17 and October 20, 2026, a critical security compromise involving Certificate Authorities that are managed by  eMudhra was uncovered. items.title: Cisco NX-OS Software Control Plane Denial of Service Vulnerability
items.summary: A vulnerability in Cisco NX-OS Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to exhaust system resources, causing a denial of service (DoS) condition. This vulnerability exists because rate limiting was improperly applied to some protocols. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a high rate of UDP or TCP connections to a data plane interface on an affected device.
